action.export.summary: Write one run as ordinary files in a new project folder (default exports/<operationId>): the script that ran, from the run's own record; each declared output as the run left it; and provenance.json with PROVENANCE.md, saying where each file came from and what was checked. A declared file that was not written, or no longer matches the inventory the run wrote, is named and left out. When the script has unsaved changes, unsaved must be "include" or "leave". Runs nothing and never writes into an existing folder.

action.lookup.summary: Read the original accepted operation. Missing acknowledgement is not permission for a new identity.

action.observe.summary: Observe original Core facts. Never starts or recovers a Host.

action.submit.summary: Execute the explicitly selected project R script snapshot and requirements. Persist operationId before delivery; identical retries retain the original Core identity. Output directory is the first R argument, followed by explicit args or frozen resource paths. Artifact paths are output-relative; completion is run-directory-relative, returned as plan.completion, so an inventory can remain beside immutable producer artifacts.

artifact.check.summary: Verify the selected completion inventory and file bytes only; domain check reports remain project resources.

binding.activity.append.summary: Registered native adapter only: retain original CLI tool and artifact-ready observations. This does not execute, validate, or present artifacts.

binding.open.summary: Bind this external session to the authenticated project scope. Conversation stays in Claude Code.

capability.configure.summary: Persist the selected project plugins with a conditional version and idempotent changeId. This changes routing only; it installs no package, starts no runtime and cancels no work.

capability.index.summary: Read a small role-narrowed index of currently authorized, enabled operations and immutable Skill/contract references.

capability.list.summary: Read registered actions and components. Does not start R or a Core Host.

capability.resolve.summary: Fetch selected relevant Skills with complete owner contracts, whole objects only. Pages pin catalog/bundle/caller; knownRefs only reuse currently available immutable bodies.

context.read.summary: Read an explicit versioned context package. Receipt establishes a tool fetch, not proactive delivery to a conversation.

conversation.permission.summary: Person at this machine only: record an offered choice for a pending Agent permission request. The original request identity is retained; repeated identical choices do not respond twice.

conversation.read.summary: Read a conversation started in Rho: the person's messages, the Agent's visible text and tool steps, and how each message ended. Reading starts and resumes nothing.

conversation.send.summary: Person at this machine only: send the next message to a conversation started in Rho, which resumes the same Claude Code session. Refused while the previous message is being answered. A repeated changeId with the same text returns the original message.

conversation.start.summary: Person at this machine only: start a conversation with Claude Code in this project. Rho selects the Agent plugin backend, attaches this project's MCP grant and records the message before sending it. A repeated changeId with the same text returns the original conversation and starts nothing.

conversation.stop.summary: Person at this machine only: ask Claude Code to stop answering one message. ACP cancellation is confirmed by the original prompt response; a lost connection keeps the outcome unknown. Legacy CLI conversations confirm process exit. Steps already taken stay done.

data.compare.summary: Join two explicit table versions using declared keys, namespaces, fields and join policy. Scientific comparability remains the project responsibility.

document.edit.summary: Apply conditional UTF-16 text edits to the shared buffer; keep the returned version.

document.read.summary: Read the shared acknowledged buffer, including unsaved text and its version.

feedback.read.summary: Original business binding only: fetch one complete frozen feedback object using its original delivery/context and a stable fetchId. relatedDocumentId is a pointer: read its CURRENT version before conditional edit/save and preserve human changes. This owner-served receipt does not prove client return or understanding.

feedback.status.summary: Observe original delivery, exact-target fetches and explicitly linked replies. No send, session start or recovery. Keep original identities and unknown outcomes; continuation cursors pin their snapshot.

feedback.submit.summary: Teacher browser only: freeze the original draft/anchor, prepare the committed message and retain one original-session delivery. Preserve submissionId across missing acknowledgements; stages are separate durable facts.

object.read.summary: Read a bounded exported JSON object snapshot, not live R memory.

project.doctor.summary: Report whether this project can actually do work right now: Core binary, Rscript, write access to the project and state folders, plugin selection, Host socket and unfinished runs. Each check carries the next action when it does not pass. It starts no Host and changes nothing.

project.entries.summary: List one level of a folder in this project: ordinary files and folders, bounded and confined to that folder, excluding owner state. The project folder lists the source folders it works in as @<sourceId> entries, which descend like any other folder. Listing reads no file contents and starts no runtime.

project.openFile.summary: Open one text file from the selected project as a document and place it in the person's own layout in one conditional step, so a person can see and edit their own source files without an Agent. Accepts a project-relative path or the @<sourceId>/<path> reference the listing returns; it executes nothing.

project.runs.summary: Report what this project has run and what it is running: one bounded summary per operation with its execution state, accepted time, author kind, the artifact paths its plan declared, whether each of those files is on disk now, whether the producer wrote a completion inventory, and the recorded integrity and domain states. A declaration, a file on disk and a verified artifact are separate facts. It carries no request body, no code and no output text, and starts nothing.

protocol.validate.summary: Check one operation body against its versioned schema without executing it: the same checks the server applies, reported with the edit each problem needs. Use it before a write whose shape is uncertain; it changes nothing and starts nothing.

requirements.check.summary: Probe only the explicitly declared R packages with bounded base R; no Core Host or project script starts.

resource.register.summary: Declare scoped existing bytes and their type/schema at the supplied digest. This read and registration starts no runtime.

skill.list.summary: List the application and enabled provider Skills shipped in the selected package. Skills guide discovery but do not grant authorization.

skill.read.summary: Read one versioned shipped Skill after checking its digest. A stale digest requires rereading instead of applying cached instructions.

task.map.declare.summary: Agent only: conditionally declare task items, your own kind/state vocabulary (label, tone, optional role) and the next steps you will take. Rho shows next only from this declaration and never infers it.

task.map.present.summary: Change a map placement or item card form, its parameters (including a subset) or the focus. Shared by the Agent and people. An Agent change to a pinned target, or within agentFormIntervalMs of its last applied form change, is merged into one pending suggestion instead of applied; Agent changes stay attributed and revertible.

task.map.read.summary: Observe the task map: declared items, vocabulary, next steps, forms, pins and pending suggestions. Reading starts, resumes or reruns nothing.

task.map.respond.summary: Browser person only: pin or unpin what they see, revert an Agent form change (layout only, never the work), or accept/dismiss a pending suggestion.

task.routing.put.summary: Control plane only: conditionally assign one task and business binding to this project without starting a native session.

workspace.enhance.summary: Assigned presenter only: conditional display emphasis/title/plain Agent note using exact current generation, witness and observation. Does not modify business resources, feedback or protection.

workspace.observe.summary: Assigned presenter only: bounded layout/basis/owner summary/visibility projection. No feedback, full documents or native trace. Reading starts no model or renderer.
